A_scene.heading: SCENE 04 — A CONVERSATION THAT CHANGES EVERYTHING
A_scene.title: A CONVERSATION THAT CHANGES EVERYTHING
A_scene.summary: Returning the phone leads to a warm exchange about Kasun's business. Her father's call about marriage changes Anudi's mood and ends the meeting.
A_scene.purpose: Establish mutual interest and Kasun's ambition while introducing the family pressure that interrupts their connection.

before_in_story.heading: SCENE 03 — THE UNEXPECTED ENCOUNTER
before_in_story.ends_with: Anudi hears him and turns around. Kasun approaches her, holding out the phone.
before_in_story.opens_with: Anudi walks past Kasun's three-wheeler while holding her umbrella. She tries to put her smartphone into the side pocket of her handbag.

after_in_story.heading: SCENE 01 — A FAMILIAR FACE
after_in_story.ends_with: Kasun walks with her to her car. They exchange smiles before saying goodbye. Over these repeated meetings, their friendship gradually develops into love.
after_in_story.opens_with: A few weeks have passed. Kasun is serving customers as usual. Suddenly, a familiar voice interrupts him.
